app.name: PageReport
app.tagline: Understand what your landing page is really telling visitors.

home.title: Audit your landing page in seconds
home.subtitle: Enter a URL and we'll run a suite of clarity and conversion checks.
home.urlInvalid: Please enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://
home.urlTooltip: Paste the exact page a visitor would see — usually the one you link in ads.

report.empty: No modules have been run for this report yet.

module.pendingHint: Waiting for workers to pick this up.
module.awaitingPrerequisitesHint: Waiting for required context (page content, AI analysis) to finish before this check can run.
module.runningHint: Analyzing your page. This usually takes 30-60 seconds.

failed.title: This module failed
failed.defaultMessage: Something went wrong while running this check.

unknown.title: Unknown module
unknown.description: This module type isn't registered in the frontend yet.

pageIntelligence.label: Page intelligence
pageIntelligence.description: What the page is about, who it targets, and what it's selling — extracted from its content.

niche.label: Niche
niche.tooltip: The market or audience this page is targeting.

summary.label: Summary
summary.tooltip: A short description of what this page is and who it's for.

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.tooltip: Key terms and phrases that describe what this page is about.

products.label: Products
products.tooltip: Products or offerings detected on this page.

copyOutline.label: Copy outline
copyOutline.description: The structured skeleton of the page — headings, CTAs, and sections — parsed from its content.

copyAnalysis.label: Copy & conversion analysis
copyAnalysis.description: A CRO read on your page's words — is your copy naming the visitor's problem and guiding them to a solution, or just describing your product?

overall.scoreTooltip: A blended score across headline clarity, value proposition, problem framing, CTAs, proof, reader-centricity, specificity, and objection handling. Higher is better.

framing.label: Framing
framing.tooltip: How the page positions itself. Problem→solution pages convert meaningfully better than product-first pages for cold traffic.

extracted.heading: What we read on your page
extracted.subtitle: The lines we extracted as the core of your pitch. If these don't match what you meant, the page isn't communicating it clearly.
extracted.headline: Headline

storyBrand.heading: Is the visitor the hero?
storyBrand.subtitle: Five checks from the StoryBrand framework. Pages where the visitor is the hero — not the founder — convert far better.

userIsHero.label: Visitor is the hero
userIsHero.tooltip: The reader, not you or the product, is the protagonist of the copy.

painNamed.label: Pain is named
painNamed.tooltip: The concrete problem the visitor is experiencing is stated in their own words.

stakesClear.label: Stakes are clear
stakesClear.tooltip: The cost of not solving the problem is made real — time lost, money lost, feelings felt.

guideRole.label: You play the guide
guideRole.tooltip: The product is positioned as a tool/guide helping the visitor win, not as the hero themselves.

planClear.label: Plan is clear
planClear.tooltip: The visitor can see what to do next in 1-3 simple steps.

dimensions.heading: Copy dimensions
dimensions.subtitle: Eight conversion fundamentals, scored from 0 to 5.

headline_clarity.label: Headline clarity
headline_clarity.tooltip: Is the headline specific, benefit-led, and understandable in 5 seconds?

value_prop.label: Value proposition
value_prop.tooltip: Is there a clear, differentiated promise of value the visitor gets?

problem_framing.label: Problem framing
problem_framing.tooltip: Does the copy name the visitor's pain before pitching the solution?

cta_strength.label: CTA strength
cta_strength.tooltip: Are CTAs action-verb-led, value-laden, specific, and unambiguous?

proof.label: Proof & credibility
proof.tooltip: Is there credible social proof — testimonials, numbers, logos, or authority markers?

reader_centricity.label: Reader-centricity
reader_centricity.tooltip: Does the copy speak to "you" rather than "we/I/our product"?

specificity.label: Specificity
specificity.tooltip: Concrete numbers, names, timeframes — versus vague marketing claims.

objection_handling.label: Objection handling
objection_handling.tooltip: Are common buyer objections anticipated and answered on the page?

quickWins.heading: Quick-win rewrites
quickWins.subtitle: Paste-ready rewrites for the lines that are costing you the most conversions.
quickWins.empty: No obvious quick wins — the copy issues here need a deeper rewrite.

ctaAudit.label: CTA audit
ctaAudit.description: A quick check on your primary call-to-action — is it visible above the fold, and does its link actually go somewhere?

primary.heading: Primary CTA
primary.notDetected: We couldn't find a primary call-to-action on this page.

hasPrimaryCta.label: Has a primary CTA
hasPrimaryCta.tooltip: Every landing page needs one clear primary action. If visitors can't spot it, they won't take it.

aboveTheFold.label: Above the fold
aboveTheFold.tooltip: Visitors shouldn't have to scroll to find the primary action. A CTA buried below the fold loses most of its clicks.

hrefWorks.label: Link works
hrefWorks.tooltip: The CTA must point to a real destination — not '#', not an empty href, not javascript:void(0).

visuallyProminent.label: Visually prominent
visuallyProminent.tooltip: The CTA should stand out with strong contrast, clear button styling, and enough size to feel clickable at a glance.

vibeCodedAudit.label: Is this page vibe-coded?
vibeCodedAudit.description: Checks if your page reads as a generic AI-generated template — too many gradients, icon cards, or stock patterns.

confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.tooltip: How sure we are about the verdict based on visual and structural signals.

summary.label: Verdict
summary.tooltip: A brief, plain-language take on whether the page looks templated or custom.

fiveSecTest.label: 5-Second Test
fiveSecTest.description: Simulates a first-time visitor's 5-second glance at your page.

summary.label: Overall impression
summary.tooltip: A short summary of what stands out in the first 5 seconds.

whatItsAbout.label: What the page is about
whatItsAbout.tooltip: What visitors think your page is selling or offering.

primaryAction.label: Primary action
primaryAction.tooltip: The single most obvious thing visitors feel they should do.

impressions.label: Raw impressions
impressions.tooltip: Unfiltered thoughts a first-time visitor might have.

topPerformers.label: Top performers in your niche
topPerformers.description: Pages in your space that are already converting — study what's working for them.

header.title: Top performers in your niche
header.subtitle: Real pages you can draw inspiration from — we picked ones that are demonstrably converting in your space.
header.tooltip: We matched your page's niche to the closest spaces and pulled the best-performing examples for each.

pages.empty: We couldn't find strong matches for this niche yet. Try refining the page's focus and re-running.

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.tooltip: Estimated monthly revenue for this page.

trustSocialProofAudit.label: Trust & social proof audit
trustSocialProofAudit.description: Visitors don't buy from pages they don't trust. We scan your full page — top to bottom — for testimonials, reviews, badges, guarantees, and social proof, then flag what's missing.

overall.scoreTooltip: How trustworthy your page feels at a glance. Weighted by the signals that actually move dropshipping conversion rates: reviews and testimonials first, then guarantees, badges, and social proof. Red flags (fake urgency, broken badges) subtract.

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.tooltip: Quoted customer voices on the page. Named testimonials with photos convert dramatically better than anonymous text blocks.
testimonials.absent: No testimonials found on the page.

reviews.label: Reviews & ratings
reviews.tooltip: Star ratings, numeric scores, and review counts — ideally from a recognised platform like Trustpilot, Google, or Judge.me.

badges.label: Trust badges
badges.tooltip: Security and payment badges that signal a safe checkout — SSL, accepted payment methods, and third-party certifications.
badges.absent: No trust or security badges detected.

guarantees.label: Guarantees
guarantees.tooltip: Promises that remove purchase risk — money-back, free shipping, warranties. The single biggest lever for first-time visitors.
guarantees.absent: No guarantees advertised on the page.

socialProof.label: Social proof
socialProof.tooltip: Third-party validation: customer logos, press mentions, follower/user counts, and expert or influencer endorsements.

urgency.label: Urgency & scarcity
urgency.tooltip: Stock counters, countdown timers and limited offers. Authentic urgency helps; fake urgency destroys trust.

gaps.heading: Missing signals
gaps.empty: No obvious gaps — the page is covering the essentials.

quickWins.heading: Quick wins
quickWins.subtitle: Small trust-building changes you can ship today.
quickWins.empty: No easy wins — the biggest gaps here need a more involved fix.

lighthouse.label: Lighthouse audit
lighthouse.description: Performance, SEO and accessibility scores from Google Lighthouse — tested on both mobile and desktop.

device.tooltip: Switch between the mobile and desktop audit results.

performance.label: Performance
performance.tooltip: How fast your page loads and becomes interactive. 90+ is good, 50–89 needs work, under 50 is poor.

seo.label: SEO
seo.tooltip: How well search engines can find and understand your page.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.tooltip: How usable your page is for people with disabilities — contrast, labels, screen-reader support.

cwv.heading: Core Web Vitals
cwv.subtitle: The Google metrics that actually affect search ranking and user experience.

lcp.label: LCP
lcp.tooltip: Largest Contentful Paint — when the biggest thing on screen appears. Under 2.5s is good.

cls.label: CLS
cls.tooltip: Cumulative Layout Shift — how much the page jumps around as it loads. Under 0.1 is good.

inp.label: INP
inp.tooltip: Interaction to Next Paint — how quickly your page reacts to clicks and taps. Under 200ms is good.

fcp.label: FCP
fcp.tooltip: First Contentful Paint — when the user first sees anything. Under 1.8s is good.

tbt.label: TBT
tbt.tooltip: Total Blocking Time — how long the page is frozen during load. Under 200ms is good.

speedIndex.label: Speed Index
speedIndex.tooltip: How quickly the page visually fills in. Under 3.4s is good.

opportunities.heading: Top fixes
opportunities.subtitle: Biggest performance wins, sorted by estimated time saved.
opportunities.empty: No major opportunities found — nice work.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
